==Notes==
*This skill is activated upon using a [[Summoning_stone|summoning stone]].
*This effect won't wear off from dying.

== Trivia ==
* The [[Feedback:Game_updates/20110505|May 5, 2011 update]] changed the duration from 60 minutes to 10 minutes.
* [https://mtg.gamepedia.com/Summoning_sickness Summoning Sickness] in the [[w:trading card game|trading card game]] [[w:Magic: the Gathering|Magic: the Gathering]] prevents newly summoned creatures from attacking on their first turn.
